say:1:1611327001:1.text: Did no one teach you to knock, Merlin?
say:1:1611327001:1.source_cn: 梅林，你又一次未经允许就闯入我的办公室了！
say:1:1611327001:1.male: Did no one teach you to knock, Merlin?
say:1:1611327001:1.female: Did no one teach you to knock, Merlin?

say:2:1611327002:1.text: This level of arrogance is unacceptable. I'll have you dismissed... Wait. How did you even get in here? This room should be protected by magic!
say:2:1611327002:1.source_cn: 你的傲慢和无礼简直令人无法忍受，我要开除你……不对，你...

choice_prompt:3:1611327002.source_cn: 你的傲慢和无礼简直令人无法忍受，我要开除你……不对，你是怎么进来的？！你根本就没有校长办公室的进入权限！

choice_prompt:3:1611327002.female: This level of arrogance is unacceptable. I'll have you dismissed... Wait. How did you even get in here? This room should be protected by magic!

say:4:1611327003:1.text: Madam Durella, I strongly suggest you calm down and listen.
say:4:1611327003:1.source_cn: 女士，先别激动。比起梅林大人的权限问题，你还是先关心你...
say:4:1611327003:1.male: Madam Durella, I strongly suggest you calm down and listen.
say:4:1611327003:1.female: Madam Durella, I strongly suggest you calm down and listen.

say:5:1611327004:1.text: As an envoy of the Lightbearer Empire, I am placing you under investigation.
say:5:1611327004:1.source_cn: 杜瑞拉，我以耀光帝国王室特使的身份，邀请你跟我走一趟。

say:7:1611327006:1.text: I obtained a report from you. It details your direct dealings with the Adamant Syndicate.
say:7:1611327006:1.source_cn: 很不巧，你遗失的那份报告现在在我手上——这上面的内容清...

say:8:1611327007:1.text: It also confirms that you released a malefic wraith during the Court Mage Selection Exam, deliberately misdirected the investigation, and endangered students.
say:8:1611327007:1.source_cn: 在宫廷魔法师选拔赛时，你利用邪念魔灵制造雷蒙校长死亡的...

say:9:1611327008:1.text: And you broke into Magister Merlin's tower, stealing multiple Memory Stars containing sealed Hypofiends. One of them matches the Hypofiend Esten "tamed" earlier today.
say:9:1611327008:1.source_cn: 除此之外，你还闯入梅林的魔法塔，抢夺了数枚装着魔物的记...
say:9:1611327008:1.male: And you broke into Magister Merlin's tower, stealing multiple Memory Stars containing sealed Hypofiends. One of them matches the Hypofiend Esten "tamed" earlier today.
say:9:1611327008:1.female: And you broke into Magister Merlin's tower, stealing multiple Memory Stars containing sealed Hypofiends. One of them matches the Hypofiend Esten "tamed" earlier today.

say:10:1611327009:1.text: At Evie's glance, you take out the empty Memory Star.
say:10:1611327009:1.source_cn: 伊芙将视线转向你，你会意地掏出了那枚空白的记忆之星。
say:10:1611327009:1.male: At Evie's glance, you take out the empty Memory Star.
say:10:1611327009:1.female: At Evie's glance, you take out the empty Memory Star.

say:11:1611327010:0.text: How... how did you get that?
say:11:1611327010:0.male: How... how did you get that?
say:11:1611327010:0.female: How... how did you get that?

choice_prompt:12:1611327010.text: How... how did you get that?
choice_prompt:12:1611327010.male: How... how did you get that?
choice_prompt:12:1611327010.female: How... how did you get that?

say:13:1611327011:1.text: Madam Durella, do you have anything to say in your defense?
say:13:1611327011:1.source_cn: 杜瑞拉女士，你还有什么要替自己辩解的吗？

say:14:1611327012:1.source_cn: 不……我……这份报告和我没关系……我是，我是被诬陷的！

say:15:1611327013:1.text: Framed? The evidence is consistent and well-documented.
say:15:1611327013:1.source_cn: 诬陷吗？但在我看来，目前的证据很确凿，已经足以逮捕你了。

say:16:1611327014:1.text: No! Mr. Aurelian, please! Tell them the truth. You're a respected member of the Academy Board. They'll listen to you!
say:16:1611327014:1.source_cn: 不，不！奥瑞利安先生，您很清楚，这些事情是对我的污蔑！...

say:18:1611327015:1.text: As I mentioned earlier, my visit is prompted by a series of recent operational irregularities at the Lyceum.
say:18:1611327015:1.source_cn: 哦……杜瑞拉女士，我刚说了，我来找你是因为近期莱希拉姆...

say:20:1611327017:1.text: Since you assumed office, administrative problems have surfaced one after another.
say:20:1611327017:1.source_cn: 在你上任之后，莱希拉姆管理问题频出。

say:21:1611327018:1.text: First, the missing Hypofiends, then the magic contracts... and now the speech loss cases. These are signs of mismanagement and a lack of accountability.
say:21:1611327018:1.source_cn: 无论是选拔赛魔物丢失，还是校园魔法契约，或者是近期的“...

say:22:1611327019:1.text: Initially, I considered it a matter of inexperience... but now, I'm inclined to suspect deliberation.
say:22:1611327019:1.source_cn: 而这些问题，自然是身为代理校长的你的责任。我起初认为这...

say:23:1611327020:1.text: In short, I see no path to continued cooperation. Board regulations oblige me to propose a replacement.
say:23:1611327020:1.source_cn: 看来我们无法继续合作了，按照规定，我有义务向董事会提议...

say:25:1611327022:0.text: Envoy Evie, please escort her. Time is a scarce resource, and as a board member, I have far more pressing matters than entertaining excuses.
say:25:1611327022:0.source_cn: 伊芙特使，快点带她走吧。我的时间很宝贵，身为学校董事，...

say:27:1611327023:0.text: Evie raises an eyebrow. You exchange a quick glance and silently agree to press Durella further.
say:27:1611327023:0.source_cn: 伊芙挑了挑眉毛，你们很快对视了一眼，应该再给杜瑞拉一点...
say:27:1611327023:0.male: Evie raises an eyebrow. You exchange a quick glance and silently agree to press Durella further.
say:27:1611327023:0.female: Evie raises an eyebrow. You exchange a quick glance and silently agree to press Durella further.

say:28:1611327024:1.text: Madam Durella, given the severity of these charges, you're facing a lengthy imprisonment.
say:28:1611327024:1.source_cn: 杜瑞拉女士，这些事情牵连非常广泛，或许你有很长一段时间...

say:29:1611327025:1.text: The public office's detention ward isn't as elegant as this place, but it will give you plenty of time to think. And perhaps come up with better explanations.
say:29:1611327025:1.source_cn: 审查所的拘留室虽然不怎么舒服，但足够宽敞。你可以在里面...

say:30:1611327026:1.text: No... Aurelian! <shk>You said everything would be fine!</shk>
say:30:1611327026:1.source_cn: 不，奥瑞利安，<shk>你承诺过不会出事的！！</shk>

say:31:1611327027:1.text: You expect me to take all the blame? I won't! If I fall, you fall with me!
say:31:1611327027:1.source_cn: 现在事情曝光了，你打算让我顶罪？好，但你也别想着能置身事外！

say:32:1611327028:1.text: Merlin, Envoy Evie... <style="highlight">He's the one behind all of this!</style>
say:32:1611327028:1.male: Merlin, Envoy Evie... <style="highlight">He's the one behind all of this!</style>
say:32:1611327028:1.female: Merlin, Envoy Evie... <style="highlight">He's the one behind all of this!</style>

say:33:1611327029:1.text: Franz worked for him. The magic contracts were his design. The speech loss outbreak was planned long in advance. Even the Grand Mentor is aligned with him!
say:33:1611327029:1.source_cn: 校园魔力契约是他主使的，弗朗茨是他的手下。失语症是他预...

say:34:1611327030:1.text: I... I was coerced into cooperation. No, manipulated. He's the real mastermind behind all this, and he's a member of the Adamant Syndicate!
say:34:1611327030:1.source_cn: 我……我是被逼着和他合作，不，我是被他操控的，我根本无...

say:35:1611327031:1.text: Under mounting pressure, Durella spills everything in a panic.

say:35:1611327031:1.male: Under mounting pressure, Durella spills everything in a panic.
say:35:1611327031:1.female: Under mounting pressure, Durella spills everything in a panic.

say:36:1611327032:1.text: Silence fills the office once she finishes. You keep your eyes on Aurelian, ready for any sudden move.

say:36:1611327032:1.female: Silence fills the office once she finishes. You keep your eyes on Aurelian, ready for any sudden move.

say:37:1611327033:3.text: But he remains calm. He slowly lifts his gaze, meets yours... and smiles.
say:37:1611327033:3.source_cn: 但奥瑞利安并没有做什么，你甚至没有从他的脸上看到一丝的...

say:37:1611327033:3.female: But he remains calm. He slowly lifts his gaze, meets yours... and smiles.

say:38:1611327034:1.text: Heh... Merlin, you've likely suspected my affiliation all along. Since that suspicion exists, we may as well lay everything on the table.

say:38:1611327034:1.female: Heh... Merlin, you've likely suspected my affiliation all along. Since that suspicion exists, we may as well lay everything on the table.

say:39:1611327035:1.source_cn: 毕竟……一名成功的商人，总得有些不为人知的商业手段，以...

cinematic_dialogue:44:1611328002:.text: I hereby enter into a contract with you.

say:46:1611329001:1.text: You... what have you done? Why is our magic disappearing?
say:46:1611329001:1.source_cn: 你……你究竟做了什么？为什么……我们的魔力会消失……

say:47:1611329002:1.text: Ah, a small clarification. Magic, like capital, never truly disappears. It only changes hands, in this case, to me.
say:47:1611329002:1.source_cn: 呵，我得纠正你言语中的错误。魔力就像债务一样不会消失，...

say:48:1611329003:1.text: But I never signed a magic contract...
say:48:1611329003:1.source_cn: 可我，没有跟你签过魔力契约……

say:49:1611329004:1.text: You should know a successful merchant always has a few tricks of his own.
say:49:1611329004:1.source_cn: 我说过了，一位成功的商人总得有点自己的小手段。

say:50:1611329005:1.text: Your <style="highlight">true name</style> is recorded on the contract. Simply not by your own hand.

say:51:1611329006:1.text: You... can steal someone's magic just by knowing their name?!
say:51:1611329006:1.source_cn: 你……你可以靠真名强制签订契约？

choice_prompt:52:1611329006.text: You... can steal someone's magic just by knowing their name?!
choice_prompt:52:1611329006.source_cn: 你……你可以靠真名强制签订契约？

say:54:1611329007:1.text: An astute observation, Merlin. What a shame. I had hoped to collect another batch of magic from the Grand Mentor.

say:54:1611329007:1.female: An astute observation, Merlin. What a shame. I had hoped to collect another batch of magic from the Grand Mentor.

say:55:1611329008:1.text: Those students drift through their studies without understanding magic's essence. Power like that, left unguided, is little more than waste.
say:55:1611329008:1.source_cn: 那些学生，他们每天都在浑浑噩噩地过日子，根本不懂魔法的...

say:56:1611329009:1.source_cn: 黑金商会也好，秘银商会也罢，它们只是“平台”和“渠道”...

say:62:1611329016:1.female: Qualities essential to any successful merchant.
